news.title: To fix Michigan schools, experts urge better reading skills, less politics
news.summary_en: A group of education experts urged audience members at the Bridge Michigan Issues Summit to volunteer in schools, vote for candidates who value education and set aside individual differences to work toward a common plan to improve schools.
news.author: Isabel Lohman

news.title: University enrollment drops 2% in Michigan, first drop in three years
news.summary_en: Nearly all of the state’s 15 public universities experienced an enrollment drop, with LSSU, EMU and NMU showing the highest rates of decline.
news.author: Kim Kozlowski
